headline: Package and conformance validator are load-bearing; all five lifecycle verbs work including rollback and uninstall. The health check verifies existence rather than integrity and its own both-states control is not wired to the exit code. platform/plugin is 252/252 green while all 7 defects below are live.

2_no_forbidden_content.detector: w4plug/scan_pkg.py - from scratch; does NOT import payload.classify_forbidden
2_no_forbidden_content.disclosed_detector_weakness: password-assign sub-pattern misses JSON-shaped "password": "..."; entry still caught by filename; 5 other secret patterns fired

4_failed_install_atomicity.reason: clean for in-process failures; a hard kill leaves a lock that blocks the next lifecycle op

B_failure_after_journal_opened.injection: live/commands/astplugin.md pre-created as a DIRECTORY so deploy fails after stage+verify+activate+record_installed

C_hard_kill_mid_transaction.method: poll journal until target step recorded, then hard kill
C_hard_kill_mid_transaction.first_attempt_discarded: fixed 0.12s kill died during interpreter startup - proved nothing

defects.summary: installed-state checks only that the version dir and manifest exist; deleting an installed runtime module leaves ok:true / exit 0, and doctor also exits 0
defects.unused_data: versions/<v>/PLUGIN-INVENTORY.json carries sha256+size for all 45 files

defects.summary: probe means 'present' not 'intact'; overwriting a deployed hook script is invisible while deleting it is caught
defects.unused_data: state/deploy-provenance.json records content_sha256 per deployed file
defects.measured: delete live/hooks/plugin_health.py -> exit 50; overwrite same file with junk -> exit 0
defects.security_note: the deployed hook is an executed script, so silent content substitution is a code-execution surface

defects.summary: health-check --controls cannot fail on an INVALID control; the harness detects a non-discriminating probe but exit code and marker are identical to healthy
defects.executable_proof: w4plug/prove_controls_not_gating.py - sabotaged one break_() to a no-op: control_invalid 0->1, exit 0->0, marker SUCCESS:health-check unchanged
defects.also: not_checked>0 is likewise invisible to the exit code

defects.summary: a hard-killed install leaves state/prefix.lock and blocks every lifecycle op for up to 1 hour
defects.measured: immediate retry -> FAILED:install E_LOCK exit 21 '(66s old)'; lock back-dated 2h -> SUCCESS:install exit 0; health-check --clear-stale-lock then install -> SUCCESS:install exit 0
defects.assessment: fail-closed, availability defect not data loss; escape hatch exists and is documented in the CLI
defects.fix: check whether the recorded PID is alive; shorten the default

defects.summary: after rollback, installed.json holds active_version 1.0.0 alongside the 1.1.0 archive's archive_sha256
defects.measured: 1.0.0 archive af62a883...; after rollback installed.json archive_sha256 aaf7bc56... (the 1.1.0 archive)
defects.blast_radius: field is only ever written (lifecycle.py:267, :312-314, :401-403); no verifier reads it, so it is a misleading record not a wrong gate verdict today

defects.summary: the probe quarantines on read, so its FAIL is not reproducible: run1 exit 50, run2 exit 0 with nothing repaired in between
defects.mitigation: evidence preserved in state/cache/quarantine/ with a .reason.json
defects.fix: split read-only probe from the existing cache --verify repair verb

defects.anchor: build.py:197 -> README.md line 27 inside the built package
defects.summary: shipped README claims 'every health probe ships a both-states control proving it fails when its invariant breaks'; the tool's own control summary reports not_checked=2 (no-open-transactions, interpreters), so it is 6 of 8
defects.class: overclaim - the code is correct and self-honest, the sentence is wider than the evidence
defects.correctly_scoped_version: 6 of 8 health probes ship a both-states control; the other 2 are reported NOT-CHECKED because no break_() is declared

defects.summary: uninstall reported kept_live_edited: [] while an owner-edited plugin-named live file remained on disk
defects.assessment: correct by provenance ownership, but the result document implies live/ is clean

lane_comparison_read_only_after_measurin.what_the_lane_did_not_do: adversarially tamper with an INSTALLED prefix or with DEPLOYED files - where D-P5-4 and D-P5-5 live - and it shipped one sentence wider than its evidence (D-P5-8)

suite.note: green while every defect above is live; none of the 252 tests catches the two health blind spots

not_checked.reason: out of this unit; the five contracted checks are all plugin-scoped. platform/marketplace (93 files) remains unverified and needs its own unit
